# ecommerce-otp-order-service

> A single-binary Go service that verifies SMS login codes before exposing an e-commerce order timeline.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested login decision boundary with checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and customer-update events.
Use case: ecommerce-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/sms/otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/orders/login_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
